name: nipopow-mixed
description: A NiPoPoW-bootstrapping joiner on one jar against serving peers on the other jar: does the joiner apply the served proof, or reject it and stall? Both arms are mixed (C runs the other role's jar via ${PEERYARD_JAR_B}), so base and candidate cover the two directions of the change. A run passes when the joiner rejects the served proof and applies none (`pass`, the hook's own PASS).
